response.explanation: The file src/presentation/server.ts is the process entry point. On line 1 it imports createGateways from src/persistence/gateways.ts, and on line 5 it passes the result into buildApp, which returns the Express app and a weather service. So the dependency is composition-root wiring: the presentation-layer file builds the persistence adapters itself and injects them, so app.ts only receives them as arguments. FF-S03 flags this because a presentation module depends directly on the persistence layer and skips the layer between them (application/domain). This is true no matter how small the import is, and the rule can't tell a wiring entry point apart from a controller reaching into storage. The code suggests wiring was the reason, since only createGateways is used and only to build the app. But nothing provided says so: there is no ADR, doc or comment calling server.ts the composition root or allowing it to import persistence. The only nearby comment (line 7) is about the daily forecast timer.
